one_line: A dedicated librarian-scholar safeguarding the Sarasvati Mahal manuscripts from the Nayaka to Maratha era in Thanjavur.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, slim but sturdy build, slightly ink-stained hands
appearance.face: oval face, warm medium-brown South Indian complexion, straight nose, thoughtful large anime-style eyes with dark irises and faint under-eye shadows, a small tilaka mark on the forehead, default expression calm and focused with a gentle, observant gaze
appearance.hair: thick black hair neatly center-parted and combed back into a low knot at the back of the head, secured with a simple dark wooden hairpin; no turban or crown, just a narrow white cotton headband circling above the forehead to suggest studious simplicity
appearance.costume: He wears an 18th‑century Thanjavur courtly scholar’s outfit: a long, straight-cut off‑white cotton angavastra-style upper cloth draped over both shoulders and across the chest like a modest shawl, layered over a pale gold silk jubba (knee‑length, long‑sleeved coat) with a simple standing collar and minimal embroidery along the front opening in dull red thread, paired with a soft reddish‑brown cotton dhoti wrapped tightly at the waist and falling to the ankles with a narrow pale gold border; his feet are in plain dark brown leather chappals, and he wears a single thin gold chain around the neck and small, round gold studs in the ears, with a palm‑leaf manuscript cord hanging diagonally from his left shoulder to right hip, subtly suggesting his librarian role.
appearance.signature: A neatly bound stack of palm-leaf manuscripts tied with a red cotton cord, cradled in his left arm, with one leaf slightly shifted to reveal compact Tamil-Sanskrit script and a small wooden stylus held between the fingers of his right hand.

ref_desc: A warm brown–complexioned oval-faced scholar with a small tilaka, black hair in a low knot and white headband, wearing an off-white angavastra over a pale gold jubba and reddish-brown dhoti with dark brown chappals, carrying bound palm-leaf manuscripts and a wooden stylus in red-accented tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a South Indian male librarian-scholar from 18th-century Thanjavur: early 30s, medium-brown complexion, oval face, large thoughtful eyes, small tilaka, and thick black hair center-parted and combed back into a low knot held by a dark wooden pin with a narrow white cotton headband. Show him wearing an off-white cotton angavastra draped modestly over both shoulders and across the chest, layered over a knee-length pale gold silk jubba with long sleeves, simple standing collar, and minimal dull red embroidery along the front edge, paired with a reddish-brown cotton dhoti wrapping the waist and falling to the ankles with a thin pale gold border. Put plain dark brown leather chappals on his feet, a thin gold chain at the neck, small round gold studs in the ears, and a diagonal manuscript cord from left shoulder to right hip. In his left arm, depict a neatly bound stack of palm-leaf manuscripts tied with a red cotton cord, and in his right hand a small wooden stylus, with one leaf slightly ajar to hint at delicate script. Use a palette dominated by off-white, pale gold, reddish-brown, dark brown, and deep red accents, and pose him calmly and upright, showing the costume and accessories clearly from head to toe against a neutral background.
